newsitem.title: USA: Browning-Ferris ends first phase of sales.
newsitem.headline: Browning-Ferris ends first phase of sales.

text.p: Browning-Ferris Industries Inc said Monday that it has successfully completed the initial phase of its planned divestitures, selling operations with $450 million in annual revenues.
The company said that the European operations it sold accounted for $190 million in annual revenues while North American divestitures accounted for $260 million.

Browning-Ferris did not disclose terms of the sales, which included its Italian waste disposal operations, as well as 64 operating locations in North America. But the company did say it received cash for those transactions.
The company added that the pace of the sales suggested continued success for future divestitures. It had announced in January that it would be selling operations with about $400 million in revenues.
Browning-Ferris is a waste services company that reported $5.8 billion in sales in fiscal 1996.
